name: neon-mdf-tools
description: Build, flash and monitor UI for neon-mdf (bootloader and application), similar to the ESP-IDF extension. Calls the existing flash_targets.cmake and .vscode/tasks.json workflows.

neonMdf.target.description: Selected target (for example, WEACT_F412), read dynamically from CMakePresets.json rather than hardcoded.

neonMdf.transport.description: Firmware programming interface. FU2: ROMCODE UART; select boot mode 100 and press RESET when the tool is ready. STM32: UART System Bootloader or JTAG/SWD, depending on the board.

neonMdf.baudRate.description: Application UART/Serial Monitor baud rate, independent of the programming baud rate. Defaults to 19200 for FU2 and 115200 for other targets when unset.

neonMdf.fu2FlashBaudRate.description: FU2 UART programming baud rate; must match the board ROMCODE. Passed when the CMake target runs; does not change the chip baud rate.

neonMdf.sdkPath.description: Absolute path to the neon-mdf SDK, similar to ESP-IDF idf.espIdfPath. Leave empty to infer it from the application location (../../neon-mdf), as in the bundled examples. Set this only when the SDK is elsewhere, using NEON-MDF: Select SDK Path... rather than editing it here.
